title: P15/P16 documents overclaimed in four places that Astra v12 found and the source confirmed (V1, V10, V18, V20)
what_went_wrong: V1: R5 section 27 said the clone check validated '1,100 tables'. The message printed the detail_nota_jalan row count (the loop variable was reused); sik has 1,179 tables. The check itself was real, the number and the claim were wrong.

V10: R5 section 28 and the p16_a_negctl.sh header said the driver tail was run 'with the oracle stubbed'; the test assigns FIX_RC and REAL_RC and runs the decision tail only, and the pin test did not assert exit 3.
V18: the v12 task summary and a failure record said 'old-vs-new controls for each N1-N8'; N2, N4, N7 and N8 had no paired arm.
V20: the P16 self-score said 'retrace trace-clean (see the commit)' with no output committed.
root_cause: Claims were written from the intent of a control, not from its transcript; the same cause as the P15 D class.
detection: Astra v12 (71/100), each finding verified against the source in the P17 task doc section 1.
impact: Four statements in documents that Astra read; none changed a result. The v12 input itself carried V18 and V1.

correction.applied: P17 D1 strike-throughs in R5 sections 27 and 28; A12 fixes the message; A10 asserts the exit code; B5 adds the missing pairs (N4, N7 judge-level, N8; N2 mechanism-only); D3 commits the retrace output.

rule: A control is described as paired only if both arms ran on the same setup; a number in a claim is copied from the transcript line that printed it, with its name.
